rationale: Sid is building video monitoring and computer-vision products at Verkada, while Manish brings deep ML infrastructure expertise from Meta and Palo Alto Networks—including hands-on experience with the ML stacks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) that power vision systems at scale. Both are based in San Francisco and their skill sets align naturally: Sid's product leadership on physical-security vision features could benefit from Manish's background optimizing ML models for production, particularly around computer-vision applications.
intro_message: Sid Dedhia, meet Manish Kumar Keshri — you're both in San Francisco working at the intersection of computer vision and production ML systems, and your PM and Staff ML Engineer perspectives could spark useful ideas around vision-powered security products.
